scope: Lexical counts in Spins and Segments regions. Runtime support is excluded. DEVICE-only host views retain other preprocessor alternatives. Counts are not reachability, optimized instruction counts, or dynamic costs. Unit detail retains all workers plus named benchmark/Map segments; anonymous continuation detail is omitted. Boundary jumps target any segment containing a host worker call, so this is an upper bound on removable adapters (especially upstream segments that also do other work). Worker declaration itself counts as one worker call in aggregate metrics; unit worker_targets excludes it.

bang_reachability_review.scope: Lexical local-definition reference closure from bench, excluding comments and strings; includes all branches, not a complete typed call graph. Independently source reviewed. Wrappers use W.bench and have no bang references.
